name: UORust
purpose: UORust reads any Cargo workspace and writes a full Prism model of it, with every facet. This page runs UORust's route table: the proved function that decides which Prism record each kind of Rust fact becomes. Enter a fact kind such as pub-fn, error-enum or unsafe-block. It answers the route, the record kind and the facet. An unknown kind is refused, never guessed.

promise.headline: Every kind of Rust fact becomes exactly one kind of Prism record, or is refused.
promise.detail: Twenty-eight routes cover crates, dependencies, public functions, tests, error and state enums, unsafe code, file, network, process and environment use, lock-file packages, lints and benchmarks. Two kinds that name different routes are refused as ambiguous, never resolved by a default.

claim: SM-02: the route table's theorems state, over the whole table and by decide, that every fact kind routes to its own row, that facts are distinct, and that any two kinds naming different routes are refused as ambiguous.

proposition.name: everyPairDecided
proposition.text:
everyFactRoutesHome routes = true
firstMatchIsSelf routes = true
everyPairDecided routes routes = true

everyPairDecided: for every two routes a and b of the table,
  classify [a.rustFact, b.rustFact] routes to a when a = b,
  and is Ambiguous a.rustFact b.rustFact otherwise
proposition.plain: Every kind in the table routes to its own row, no two rows share a kind, and two kinds of one fact that name different rows are always refused.

theorems.name: routeTableIsTotal
theorems.statement: every rust fact kind of the table, alone, routes to its own row
theorems.how: Decided by computation over the 28-row table, checked by the Lean kernel in prismpm verify

theorems.name: routeFactsAreDistinct
theorems.statement: the first row naming each kind is that kind's own row, so no two rows share a kind
theorems.how: Decided by computation, checked by the Lean kernel

theorems.name: routeTableRefusesAmbiguity
theorems.statement: for all 784 ordered pairs of rows, two kinds of different rows are refused as ambiguous
theorems.how: Decided by computation, checked by the Lean kernel

pinned.name: self_model_sm_01
pinned.what: The verified table, routeOf and the application's acceptance vectors equal model/routes.toml, which the Rust router of crates/uorust replays too. A string-matching test, not a theorem: a dropped route or vector fails it.

pinned.name: self_model_sm_02
pinned.what: The theorems' statements quantify over the whole table and are decided with no axiom.

pinned.name: no_lifted_kappa_turns_unlifted_ue_16
pinned.what: No function that the committed lift register, frontier.toml, records as lifted under the κ of its crate path and tokens is decided otherwise by a later projection. The register's unlifted rows are the distance to the requirement that every function of product code lifts: measureUnliftedFunctions has threshold 0 and its excess is reported as an open claim by the honesty report, not gated.
